Scripts.OnShow: if (AuctionFrame and AuctionFrame:IsShown()) then Atr_Mask:Show(); end;
Scripts.OnHide: if (AuctionFrame and AuctionFrame:IsShown()) then Atr_Mask:Hide(); end;

Scripts.OnShow: PlaySound("UChatScrollButton"); -- Nothing here may select a tab. Atr_UpdateUI sets the -- highlight from pane.showWhich and THEN calls Show(), so a -- selection made in this handler runs last and overwrites the -- correct one with tab 1, while the rows underneath stay on -- whatever was really chosen. IsScanEmpty() flips between -- every search, so the frame hides and reshows constantly and -- this fired all the time. OnLoad seeds the initial tab; that -- one is correct and must stay.
